rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice when someone performs or achieves better than B.

example.english: This time I outdo my previous performance and finally win the championship.
example.traditional: 今次我做得好過上次，終於攞到冠軍。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 ngo5 zou6 dak1 hou2 gwo3 soeng6 ci3 zung1 jyu1 lo2 dou3 gun3 gwan1

rows.note: Use this when outdoing someone means beating them in a competition or comparison.

example.english: I finally managed to outdo B in this competition.
example.traditional: 今次比賽我終於贏過 B 喇。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 bei2 coi3 ngo5 zung1 jyu1 jeng4 gwo3 b1 laa3

rows.note: Use this for surpassing a person, limit, or one’s previous performance, especially in more formal contexts.

example.english: This result managed to outdo B and set a personal best.
example.traditional: 今次嘅成績成功超越 B，創下個人新高。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 ge3 sing4 zik1 sing4 gung1 ciu1 jyut6 b1 cong3 haa6 go3 jan4 san1 gou1
